description: Zigbee 3.0 environment sensor application (Router) with DHT11 temperature/humidity on PD8, button input, and network manager. Recycled from Z3_Occupancy_Sensor. Uses NVM3 persistent storage.

build.toolchain: GNU ARM 12.2.rel1 (SimplicityStudio_v5 toolchain; system 10.3.1 link-fails on --no-warn-rwx-segments)
build.ide: CLI make (Studio-generated makefile cloned from Z3_Occupancy_Sensor, paths rewritten)

binaries.flash_command: commander flash artifact/Z3_DHT11_Sensor/Z3_DHT11_Sensor.s37 --serialno <kit-jlink> (no masserase: preserves MFG install-code token + NVM3)

build_instructions: Build dir: ~/SimplicityStudio/v5_workspace/Z3_DHT11_Sensor/'GNU ARM v12.2.1 - Default' (sources sync from end_devices/Z3_DHT11_Sensor via ~/ss_v5/v5_workspace/Z3_DHT11_Sensor). PATH must include /home/phu/SimplicityStudio_v5/developer/toolchains/gnu_arm/12.2.rel1_2023.7/bin, then `make all -j$(nproc)`. See docs/handoff/dht11_environment_sensor_local_handoff.md.
